normative_extracts.spec_section: 2. Box Layout Modes: the display property
normative_extracts.quote: An element with display: none generates no boxes in the formatting structure, whereas visibility: hidden generates invisible boxes that still participate in layout.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Style resolution attaches ComputedStyle to DOM elements; LayoutNG walks the box tree to compute physical pixel coordinates.

production_failures.symptom: Toggling visibility on a 1,000-row table triggers a 45ms frame drop
production_failures.root_cause: Using display: none destroys and recreates LayoutObjects and invalidates ancestor layout geometry.
production_failures.mitigation: Use visibility: hidden or content-visibility: hidden when preserving layout boxes across frequent toggles.

production_failures.symptom: CPU spikes during infinite scroll appends
production_failures.root_cause: Appending nodes into an unconstrained document forces full-document layout passes.
production_failures.mitigation: Apply contain: layout or CSS containment boundaries to isolate subtree geometry.
